coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web first pass in English, Macedonian and Albanian, using broad searches, weekly windows, city/sector leads, contemporaneous local media, Helsinki Committee reporting, CIVICUS and available official policy/traffic notices. Candidate set: one Jan29 Monstra march with qualitative estimates above 50 and directly reported same-day physical end; four dated gatherings with unresolved threshold or state target; one unresolved school-exam street-action lead and one Jan14 electricity/VAT protest search lead, both with null physical dates. Kumanovo online-class boycott is excluded as nonattendance rather than public assembly. Search coverage is not equivalent to LexisNexis and does not establish exhaustive coverage or national absence. Search results were pooled across multi-query calls where per-query mapping was unavailable; later query timestamps retain recorded_at when exact execution time was not captured.
